title: Quantum computing for effective nuclear lattice model
summary: Nuclear lattice effective field theory has become an important framework for quantum many-body calculations in nuclear physics, yet its classical implementation remains increasingly challenging for more general interactions and larger systems. In this work, we develop a quantum-computing framework for a three-dimensional nuclear lattice model. We construct a variational quantum eigensolver framework and systematically compare the Jordan-Wigner and Gray code encodings.
